messages:
maya: Quick sync — v2 endpoint deprecation: we need final owners for the remaining endpoints and SDK shim owners by EOD. I pasted the stub matrix below, please reply with your lane or :no_entry: if blocked.

maya: matrix: https://go/internal/v2-deprec-matrix (row per endpoint, col: owner, shim, infra-deps)

aj: I can take /payments and /invoices. Will do a brief PR to add the shim tests.

sam: I’ll own SDK runtime compatibility (Python + JS). Heads-up: there's an open failing test in js-sdk that blocks canary.

leah: infra note — quota for canaries in us-west is low this week. @infra-bot can you reserve 2 additional slots for 6/25-6/27? :pray:

infra-bot: Reservation request received. Tried to allocate 2 x p4d for us-west-2, currently pending approval from ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: Approved reserve for 2 x p4d from 2026-06-25 00:00 to 2026-06-27 23:59. Please annotate the PR with the reservation ID: res-20260625-02

aj: thx @ops-oncall — I'll note res-20260625-02 in the PR template.

sam: for the js-sdk failing test, stack trace snippet:
```
TypeError: kvCache.set is not a function
    at warmKvCache (/src/runtime/cache.js:42:15)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
I'll open a quick patch, but need someone from eng-runtime to confirm if the new cache API is rolled out.

maya: tagging eng-runtime implicitly — @leah can you ping runtime infra folks? If cache API isn't stable we should hold the canary and add an automated fallback in the shim.

leah: pinged runtime-signal in DMs, got ack. They said the cache API is staged in staging only; rollout to prod is delayed by one day. Suggestion: add a feature-flagged fallback in the JS shim so v2 calls don't fail during the staged rollout.

sam: ok I'll implement a `kvCache?.set` safe-path with a feature flag and add a unit test.

devex-bot: Reminder: SDK update checklist template: add changelog entry, migration notes, link to migration guide: https://go/internal/sdk-migrate-v2

maya: Owners tally so far: /payments: aj, /invoices: aj, SDK-js: sam (shim + fallback), SDK-py: sam, infra reservations: leah. Still need owners for /users, /auth, and the iOS SDK shim.

aj: I'll take /users if nobody else wants it.

leah: iOS SDK — I can ask mobile-plat to assign, but short on bandwidth. Can someone else volunteer?

maya: @devex-bot any volunteers from mobile-plat? If no response by 2pm PT we'll assign to mobile oncall and follow up.

devex-bot: Notified mobile-plat channel.

mobile-plat (via devex-bot): Can take iOS shim, will update owner in matrix by EOD.

maya: Perfect. Final checklist for EOD:
- owners added to matrix (everyone)
- PRs for shims opened (aj/sam/mobile-plat)
- infra reservation annotated in PRs (aj)
- feature-flag fallback in js shim (sam)
- QA canary window scheduled (leah)

maya: If anyone is blocked, reply here. Otherwise I’ll compile the owner list and send to PMs.

aj: No blockers from payments side. :thumbsup:

sam: Patch for js shim opened: https://go/internal/pr/12345 — includes `kvCache?.set` fallback and unit test.

leah: Canary scheduled and annotated in deployment calendar: https://go/internal/deploy-calendar#res-20260625-02

maya: Thanks all — I’ll send summary to #product and mark this matrix row as 'ready for deprec gate'.
